// diagnostic

E0364

This range includes `{xs}.len()`, one past the last index.

What

This range includes `{xs}.len()`, one past the last index.

Why

An inclusive range that ends at a list's length runs one step too far when the body indexes that list.

Fix

Write `loop (i, item) in xs` — or `loop i in xs.indexes()` — or `0..<xs.len()`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0364: tests/ui/range_len_index_trap.stderr.

Error [E0364]: this range includes `xs.len()`, one past the last index
  --> tests/ui/range_len_index_trap.jet:3:21
    |
  3 |     loop i in 0..xs.len() -> print("{xs[i]}")
    |                     ^^^
 Why: `xs.len()` is the count of items, so inclusive `..` runs one step too far when the body indexes `xs`
 Fix: write `loop (i, item) in xs` — or `loop i in xs.indexes` — or `0..<xs.len()`
